name: capsule-creator
description: Create, build, verify, run, and black-box test exceptional offline SQLite Capsule applications without a repository checkout or native client.

interface.longDescription: Scaffold reviewable source, design bounded named interfaces and polished offline UI, build with the bundled Python runtime, verify against an independent contract, and black-box inspect the result with the included Fluent Capsule Inspector.
defaultPrompt: Create a new offline SQLite Capsule application.
Turn this application brief into a verified capsule.
Build and smoke-test this capsule project.
Inspect this capsule as a black box.
